mapper.select: SELECT ddovyo.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.user_source, t.user_num FROM (select dur.dates, dur.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic') user_source, count(1) user_num from dwd_user_register dur left join dim_user_source dus on (dur.user_id = dus.user_id) where dur.dates = #{dates} group by dur.dates, dur.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_usrc_register ddovyo on (t.dates = ddovyo.dates and t.pkg = ddovyo.pkg and t.user_source = ddovyo.user_source)
